definitions.explanation: One of the individual leaf-like parts that make up the head of a flower. A common word in everyday Japanese and frequently used in poetic and literary imagery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{花|はな}びら⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{散|ち}っている→散る：02075_chiru⟧。
⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}って→乗る：00511_noru⟧{花|はな}びら⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞|ま}い{上|あ}がった→舞い上がる：06043_maiagaru⟧。
examples.english: Petals danced up on the wind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水面|すいめん}→水面：04307_suimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浮|う}かんだ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧{花|はな}びら⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}っていた→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: The petals floating on the water's surface formed a beautiful pattern.

notes:
USAGE:
One of the most common nature words in Japanese. ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{花|はな}びら (cherry blossom petals) is an iconic image in Japanese culture and poetry. The word is native Japanese (wago) and is usually written in kana for ⟦びら→ビラ：11240_bira⟧, though the kanji {花弁|はなびら} exists.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {花|はな}びら⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{散|ち}る→散る：02075_chiru⟧: petals fall/scatter
- {花|はな}びら⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞|ま}う→舞う：04573_mau⟧: petals flutter/dance
- {花|はな}びら⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧: petals float
- ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{花|はな}びら: cherry blossom petals
- ⟦{薔薇|ばら}→薔薇：04390_bara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{花|はな}びら: rose petals
